semiconductor_relevance: High — System Technology (Shenzhen) Co., Ltd. specializes in grinding systems and abrasive products that are essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: System Technology (Shenzhen) Co., Ltd. provides advanced grinding solutions and high-end abrasive products tailored for semiconductor applications, including wafer scribing and precision grinding. The company focuses on innovative methodologies to enhance grinding processes in the semiconductor and automotive industries.
capabilities: Wafer and packaging substrate scribing solutions
Precision grinding systems for automotive parts
Innovative abrasive design for grinding applications

regional_presence.China: The company is based in Shenzhen, where it was founded and operates its primary business.
